title: Dig It Soft
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The ground had gone all hard and dry,
No little seed could grow;
Hosea said, "Go break it up,
And dig it soft and low."

[Chorus]
Break up the hard ground, dig it soft,
And plant good seeds with care;
Then look for Him, He sends the rain
Of goodness everywhere.

[Verse 2]
Our hearts can get like that hard ground,
All grumpy, tight and sore;
But saying sorry softens them
And makes them kind once more.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Beau's tower fell down one, two, three,
His chest went hot inside;
He took a breath, began again,
And built the bottom wide.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So pick one kind thing you can plant,
Like sharing what you've got;
Then watch His goodness fall like rain
On every garden spot.

[Chorus]
mood: Digging music. A steady, patient pull under the voice, like a spade going into hard ground and lifting, again and again, never hurried. Cello and nylon guitar taking turns: the cello low and even for the digging, the guitar brighter on each chorus when the rain comes. It loosens as it goes, the way the soil does, and ends warm and open in the middle of a wet garden morning.
